releaseNotes: AutoWave Radio v5.27.0: redesigned lyrics sync - lyrics no longer jump back when a station flashes its name or a slogan mid-song, lines change exactly on time, lyrics load instantly for songs heard before and retry by themselves when the lyrics service is busy. The artist name is always shown in Android Auto, song names no longer show HTML or broadcaster tags, and the Lyrics button (phone and car) now remembers your choice.
